notes: Inputs: public/graph.json; HPO reference data/reference/hpo-reference.json; AI judgments none.
Graded 1040 of 4278 disease pairs; the others share no gene, variant or mechanism, too little symptom overlap to score, and no research item beyond umbrella resources.

Three scores, never mixed: biology (gene, variant type, mechanism) sets the distance on the map; clinical resemblance (symptoms, onset, inheritance) is shown beside it; collaboration (shared groups, papers, studies, grants, researchers, registries) never moves a disease.
Pairs listed: every pair in a disease's biology neighbors or clinical look-alikes; 1 research bridge between diseases outside those lists is in bridges only.

Mechanism specificity within this atlas: a mechanism reached by n of the N diseases that have any mechanism on record (N = 81 of 93 here) weighs (1 - ln n / ln N) / (1 - ln 2 / ln N), at least 0.15; a pair scores the weight of the most specific mechanism both reach, and a mechanism that comes only with a gene the pair shares is not counted again.

Variant type compares only the variants that can stand for each disease: those linked to the disease, and those of a gene with no other disease here (34 of 52 genes); a gene of several diseases records its variants for the gene, not for any one of its diseases, so those are set aside.

Symptom similarity: SimGIC over HPO 2026-09-01 (annotations 2026-09-02). Scaled 0 at 0.1636 (the 99th percentile of 20000 random disease pairs) to 1 at 0.3173 (the median SimGIC of 497 pairs of OMIM and Orphanet records of the same disease); pairs below the 95th percentile of random pairs score 0. Onset and inheritance count only once the symptoms score above 0.

Settings (lib/grading/config.ts and the fixed rules in lib/grading/dimensions.ts): mechanism match at 0.6, specificity once 3 diseases have a mechanism, pathway size weighed against 20000 genes; variant type compares only variants that can stand for the disease (linked to it, or of a gene with no other disease here), needs 2 classified a side, matches at 0.75 or the same kind on both sides (mostly loss-of-function from 2/3, mostly missense or in-frame up to 0.2), partial at 0.4, and counts toward biology only at match or partial; symptoms match at 0.6 and partial at 0.25 on the scaled score (raw overlap 0.3 and 0.15 without a reference), top 0.32 when a reference has no same-disease anchor, worded "as much as two records of the same disease" from 0.9; a symptom is rare at ic 0.5 or more and generic below 0.3, and fewer than 10 symptoms is a thin record: a pair with a thin record that shares at most one identical symptom, or no rare one, is at most "Looks somewhat similar"; onset ladder HP:0003577, HP:0003623, HP:0003593, HP:0011463, HP:0003621, HP:0003581 with neighbouring steps at 0.5, onset 0.8 and inheritance 0.2, match at 0.75 and partial at 0.5; collaboration 1 - prod(1 - 0.5 x w) over shared items, w the item's specificity among the diseases with any item of that kind on record; umbrella resources (flagged, never a bridge) are items linked to more than max(4, 0.1 x N) diseases, 9.3 here; numbers rounded to 4 decimals.
